description: First call with adId to get the real credit quote without spending. Show the user the cost and ask for approval. Only then call again with confirm: true and expectedCredits equal to totalCredits from the quote. A changed quote requires approval again. Uses the studio's paid render service; check progress and finish/export in the results URL.

adId.description: The ad's id, from list_ads or generate_ad_script.

confirm.description: True only after the user approves the quoted credit cost.

expectedCredits.description: The exact totalCredits the user approved.

name: render_ad
title: Render ad (spends credits, requires confirmation)
